svg.title: Easy Vibe: from idea to product engineer
svg.desc: A course progression, not a software release timeline. Stage 1: research and validate user needs, build with Cursor or Claude, and integrate AI. Stage 2: Figma, GitHub, Supabase, Dify, Zeabur, and Stripe for complete delivery. Stage 3: Claude Code, MCP, Skills, Agent Teams, and cross-platform apps. Based on the course chapters in this repository.

g.text: 发现问题 · 验证需求 · 构建产品 · 持续迭代
Find a problem. Validate it with real users.
Design, build, deploy, and get feedback.
